description: Run a failing test multiple times with retries disabled and return an evidence-based verdict: CONSISTENTLY FAILING (real bug), FLAKY (intermittent — includes pass/fail counts and error-signature variance) or NOT REPRODUCING (one-off). Defaults to the tests that failed in the most recent run.

config.description: playwright.config path or 1-based index when the project has several configs

headed.description: Run with a visible browser window

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

runs.description: How many times to run the tests (default 3)

testFiles.description: Tests to diagnose ("file:line" supported). Defaults to the tests that failed in the most recent run.

name: diagnose-flaky
title: Diagnose flaky test
